name: Майстер перетворення пішаків (3)
description:
You are going to promote your pawn again. The king will help your pawn to reach the other side of the board. This time the king uses a technique called shouldering.

Study the examples to learn how shouldering works.

  

What do you have to do?

Promote your pawn. Use your king to shoulder the black king away. Protect your pawn and make sure that the black king cannot get to the promotion square.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Yd6][%cal Yf6f8,Yf8d8,Yd8d6]} {[#]} 1. f7 Ke7 2. f8=Q+ Kxf8 *
examples.text:
The black king is inside the square.
The white king is too far away to help his pawn.
Black can catch up with the white pawn. 

Click on the arrow to watch the moves.

examples.pgn: {[%cal Yf6f8,Yf8d8,Yd8d6,Gh6g7]} {[#]} 1. f7 Ke7 2. Kg7 Kd7 3. f8=Q *
examples.text:
Here the white king has a much better position!
The pawn takes a step forward. The black king wants to stop it and moves to its side.
Now the white king follows the green arrow. This way he protects the pawn and ensures that the black king cannot reach the promotion square to stop the pawn.
In the next move, the pawn will queen and cannot be captured by Black. 

Click on the arrow to watch the moves.
